name: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites with Yogurt Dill Dip
steps: Toss the florets with almond flour, oil and garlic powder and roast at 450°F for 20 minutes.
Toss with hot sauce.
Stir the yogurt with dill and serve with celery sticks.

name: Deviled Eggs with Paprika
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Mash the yolks with yogurt, mustard and salt.
Pipe or spoon back into the whites.
Dust with paprika and chives.

name: Guacamole with Veggie Dippers
steps: Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt.
Fold in the onion, tomato, cilantro and jalapeno.
Serve with cucumber and pepper strips.

name: Baked Zucchini Chips
steps: Slice the zucchini thin.
Dip in egg, then a mix of parmesan, almond flour and garlic powder.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: Chicken Salad Cucumber Cups
steps: Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds and scoop a shallow well.
Mix the chicken, yogurt, celery, mustard and dill.
Fill the cups.

name: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Veggies
steps: Chop the artichokes and wilt the spinach.
Stir with yogurt, cream cheese, parmesan and garlic.
Bake at 375°F for 18 minutes.
Serve with carrot and celery sticks.

name: Turkey Pepperoni Pizza Bites
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and remove the portobello stems.
Spoon marinara into each cap.
Top with mozzarella and sliced sausage.
Bake 15 minutes.

name: Roasted Chickpea Snack Mix
steps: Pat the chickpeas dry.
Toss with the oil and spices.
Roast at 400°F for 25 minutes, adding nuts and seeds for the last 5.

name: Pepper Jack Stuffed Jalapeno Poppers
steps: Halve and seed the jalapenos.
Mix the cream cheese, pepper jack and garlic powder and fill.
Wrap in a strip of bacon if you like.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter and Cinnamon
steps: Slice the apple.
Serve with peanut butter and a dusting of cinnamon.

name: Flourless Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Mix everything into a dough.
Scoop ten small balls and flatten with a fork.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Dark Chocolate Avocado Mousse
steps: Blend the avocado, cocoa, almond milk, vanilla and sweetener until silky.
Chill 1 hour.
Serve with raspberries.

name: Baked Cinnamon Apples
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Core the apples and fill with oats, walnuts, cinnamon and butter.
Add water to the dish and bake 30 minutes.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bark
steps: Spread the vanilla-stirred yogurt on a lined tray.
Scatter with berries, pistachios and chocolate.
Freeze 3 hours and break into pieces.

name: Pumpkin Pie Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk everything together.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Stir and serve cold.

name: Almond Flour Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line eight muffin cups.
Whisk the almond flour, baking powder and sweetener.
Mix in eggs, yogurt, melted butter and vanilla, then fold in the blueberries.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Sugar-Free Chocolate Dipped Strawberries
steps: Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil.
Dip the dry strawberries.
Set on parchment in the fridge for 15 minutes.

name: Green Smoothie with Spinach and Pineapple
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Serve cold.

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Protein Shake
steps: Blend with ice until smooth.

name: Mixed Berry Kefir Smoothie with Flax
steps: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Iced Green Tea with Lemon and Mint
steps: Steep the tea and chill.
Add lemon, mint and a pinch of stevia.
Serve over ice.

name: Golden Turmeric Latte
steps: Warm the almond milk with the spices.
Whisk until frothy and serve.

name: Cucumber Mint Sparkling Cooler
steps: Muddle the cucumber and mint with the lime juice.
Top with sparkling water over ice.
